summary: Router 0.29.1: outside modes.upstream_window the window check held an idle OpenAI-compatible server only if the router's last order was not "hold"; a server the agent started unheld after a restart without upstream.json (to learn it) therefore kept running idle and holding RAM. A hold now counts as under way for 60 s after it was sent (new Node.upstream_order_at, set in openai_node.order); after that the agent's report (upstream_state "", serving not the standby) decides. Traced: tick_loop -> upstream_window_check -> openai_node.order -> registry.send_ctl {"t":"upstream-hold"} over the authenticated agent tunnel (unchanged; only to agents reporting upstream_releasable). No new route, input, privilege or configuration key. The change can only send more holds, never more releases; at most one window order per node per WINDOW_ORDER_GAP_S (30 s) and, while the agent still reports the server answering, one hold per 60 s grace; the agent ignores a repeated order.

findings.evidence: Pre-existing gap fixed here: an idle server started unheld by the agent was never held outside the window because the router keyed on its own remembered order instead of the agent's report; observed running idle for hours at about 74 % RAM on a desktop node, which keeps the RAM gate of ADR-0037/ADR-0092 from letting anything else in and, on that node, has caused instability before.
findings.resolution: upstream_window_check keys on the agent's report after HOLD_REPORT_GRACE_S. Test: selftest_upstream_window.py reproduces it (last order hold an hour ago, agent reports running, idle > idle_hold_s outside the window -> hold sent; failed before the fix), plus the cases a recent use (no hold), a hold sent seconds ago (no second hold) and a remembered order without a time (hold).

tests.evidence: 0 failures (2 failures before the fix in poll.py)

tests.command: ruff check .; python router/router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure; python test/selftest_control_flow.py && python test/check_control_flow.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; configuration ok; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings
End-to-end suite runs nightly in CI; the change is limited to the window check, covered by its self-test.

limitations: Not checked against a live node; the reproduction is the self-test with the agent's report as observed.
The 60 s grace is a fixed constant; an agent that needs longer to report a hold would receive one repeated hold, which it ignores.
